<script lang="ts" setup>
import { MonthPickerRoot, type MonthPickerRootEmits, type MonthPickerRootProps, useForwardPropsEmits } from 'reka-ui';
import { MonthPickerCell, MonthPickerCellTrigger, MonthPickerGrid, MonthPickerGridBody, MonthPickerGridRow, MonthPickerHeader, MonthPickerHeading, MonthPickerNextButton, MonthPickerPrevButton } from '.';

const props = defineProps<MonthPickerRootProps>();
const emits = defineEmits<MonthPickerRootEmits>();
const forwarded = useForwardPropsEmits(props, emits);
</script>

<template>
  <MonthPickerRoot
    v-slot="{ grid }"
    data-slot="month-picker"
    class="sigma-ui-month-picker"
    v-bind="forwarded"
    :class="[$attrs.class]"
  >
    <MonthPickerHeader>
      <MonthPickerPrevButton />
      <MonthPickerHeading />
      <MonthPickerNextButton />
    </MonthPickerHeader>
    <MonthPickerGrid>
      <MonthPickerGridBody>
        <MonthPickerGridRow
          v-for="(row, index) in grid.rows"
          :key="index"
          class="sigma-ui-month-picker__row"
        >
          <MonthPickerCell
            v-for="date in row"
            :key="date.toString()"
            :date="date"
          >
            <MonthPickerCellTrigger :month="date" />
          </MonthPickerCell>
        </MonthPickerGridRow>
      </MonthPickerGridBody>
    </MonthPickerGrid>
  </MonthPickerRoot>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-month-picker {
  width: fit-content;
  padding: 0.75rem;
  border: 1px solid var(--border);
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
}

.sigma-ui-month-picker__row {
  width: 100%;
  margin-top: 0.5rem;
}
</style>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { MonthPickerCell, type MonthPickerCellProps, useForwardProps } from 'reka-ui';

const props = defineProps<MonthPickerCellProps>();
const forwarded = useForwardProps(props);
</script>

    data-slot="month-picker-cell"

    <slot />
  </MonthPickerCell>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell {
  position: relative;
  padding: 0;
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  text-align: center;
}
</style>

    <slot />
  </MonthPickerCellTrigger>
</template>

<style>
.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell-trigger {
  display: inline-flex;
  min-width: 4.5rem;
  height: 2rem;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: var(--radius-md);
  font-size: 0.875rem;
  padding-inline: 0.5rem;
}

.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell-trigger:hover {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell-trigger:focus-visible {
  outline: 2px solid var(--ring);
}

.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell-trigger[data-selected] {
  background-color: var(--primary);
  color: var(--primary-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell-trigger[data-today]:not([data-selected]) {
  background-color: var(--accent);
  color: var(--accent-foreground);
}

.sigma-ui-month-picker-cell-trigger[data-disabled] {
  opacity: 0.5;
  pointer-events: none;
}
</style>
